prompts.generation:
Use case: stylized-concept / game UI cutout.
Reference image: the supplied aged pewter book corner fitting. This is the exact material, lighting, monochrome color and ornament style to match.
Generate ONE closed ancient metal BOOK CLASP LOCK for the CENTER OF THE RIGHT EDGE of the same closed leather book. Straight overhead orthographic view, front cover plane parallel to the image. A horizontal short broad latch comes in FROM THE RIGHT and fastens onto a modest ornate plate to its LEFT, with a small old-fashioned keyhole integrated into the plate, a few dulled rivets and a believable hinge at the rightmost end. It should read as attached book hardware, not a freestanding padlock, door handle or belt buckle. Clear silhouette, compact, practical, restrained medieval fantasy scrollwork matching the reference's curved flourishes. The rightmost end is a flat vertical mounting edge for alignment with the right edge of the UI book cover.
Very old, well-used, pitted pewter/blackened silver, rubbed shallow relief edges, light scuffs, small cracks and darkened recesses; the same rich painterly realistic worn metal as the reference. Strict neutral grayscale with exactly the reference's muted brightness. Soft near-omnidirectional diffuse illumination and restrained pale highlights; no bright gleams, directional cast shadow, glow or color. No baked shadow outside the silhouette; the addon adds its own contact shadow.
Entire clasp visible, horizontally oriented, centered with only modest transparent padding around its silhouette. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Genuinely transparent alpha outside and through any open gaps. No leather, book, background, checkerboard, rectangular backing, text, runes, extra objects, multiple variants, corner fittings or UI.
